You are the independent final adjudicator. Read all 24 untruncated original reports, the four independent judge reports, the frozen sample and source audit below. Do not majority-vote, silently average incompatible values, upgrade unverified sources or invent missing numbers. Resolve each material disagreement by evidence quality. Report missingness and correct denominators. Write the complete final output requested in the user brief, including all 12 questions, all 18 categories, both separate distributions, four shipping structures and separate architectures. Give all requested verdicts: broad/narrow/thin routing/full marketplace as well as shopping agent/logistics platform, Strong/Moderate/Weak/Rejected with confidence, decisive evidence, strongest counterargument and change-of-mind data. Use explicit source URLs and artifact/claim identifiers, and preserve confirmed/probable/speculative reasons. If data do not support a distribution, say so instead of constructing one. Finish with a concrete $10,000 uncertainty-reducing research program.

All complete original inputs are in the attached final-synthesis-evidence.txt; SHA256 2be95283fa0dd89ba6dc026cea8642e5c2766fe45fbc1fe0e47f10ae052db4c2. Read all inputs using available file tools. Include a completeness table for the 24 research reports and four judges, each with a specific inspected finding. If any input cannot be inspected, say INPUT_INCOMPLETE and identify exactly what failed; do not claim a complete synthesis. All missing real prices/rates/weights remain missing. Return the complete Chinese deliverable requested in the original user brief in the attachment, with explicit source URLs and evidence IDs. Do not invent quantiles from incomplete landed costs. This is the final report, not a plan.
